jobs.title: Senior Director - Chief Developer and AI Adoption
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**What is the opportunity?**


As a Senior Director \- Chief Developer and AI Adoption, you will lead a team of Technology \& Operations AI Developers who build the next\-generation technology that changes how millions of people interact with financial information and one another. Our products need to handle information on a massive scale and extend well beyond traditional banking.

  

The RBC Business Financial Service Technology team offers the opportunity to work within the transformation program to develop innovative ideas and solutions in support of our clients and organization. We hire people with a broad range of technical skills and leadership experience. Our teams are diverse, creative and fun. As a Sr. Director, you will work within and across teams focusing on how we can empower our clients on their digital journey. Working with amazing colleagues and a variety of technological options you will be contributing to new innovative possibilities, solving interesting and challenging business problems and helping to deliver solutions that result in targeted business outcomes and great client experience.

  

This executive will establish a modern, secure, scalable, and AI\-enabled development organization. The role combines hands\-on technology leadership with enterprise\-wide transformation, ensuring that AI and automation deliver measurable improvements while meeting the bank’s standards for security, resilience, regulatory compliance, data protection, and responsible innovation.

  

The successful candidate will champion developer productivity, modern engineering practices, cloud and platform capabilities, reusable technology services, and the adoption of AI\-assisted development tools. They will partner closely with business leaders, risk, compliance, information security, data, operations, and human resources to embed AI into the bank’s operating model.

 **What will you do?**

* Maintaining relationships with clients; communicating with IT and business management. Monitoring prompt response and support for technical issues.
* Lead high performing teams, and ensure high standards and quality of technical work. Directing reviews of tools and technologies for improving performance, reducing costs and time to market.
* Define the bank’s strategy for AI\-assisted software development and engineering productivity. Partner with business and functional leaders to identify high\-value, practical AI use cases. Build communities of practice, internal learning programs, and technical enablement initiatives for developers and business users.
* Lead the adoption of approved AI coding assistants, code\-generation tools, testing tools, documentation solutions, developer copilots, and software delivery automation.
* Ensure AI and software development practices comply with applicable banking regulations, supervisory expectations, internal policies, and contractual obligations.
* Establish appropriate controls for the use of generative AI in development, including secure handling of source code, customer data, confidential information, and intellectual property.
* Develop standards for human review, model evaluation, testing, explainability, auditability, and accountability when AI is used in software development.
* Measure and communicate the impact of AI adoption on productivity, quality, delivery speed, risk, and employee experience.
* Own or contribute to technology investment planning, prioritization, and budget management.

 **What do you need to succeed?**

**Must\-have:**

* 5\- 10 years’ experience with Java, .NET, Angular (or relevant frameworks), REST API/Micro services, Spring Framework (MVC, Security, JPA, Boot), Ansi SQL (MySQL or equivalent)
* Experience with distributed cloud (Pivotal Cloud Foundry, Openshift, Docker)
* Experience in designing, developing, testing and troubleshooting code. Experience with security gateways and protocols (JWT, Oauth2\.0, SSL Certificates, Azure AD)
* Experience with event driven capabilities like Kafka. Microservices architecture design, development and implementation.
* Experience with secure CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience leveraging Gen\-AI capabilities including Claude, CoPilot or others to generate code, data \& deliver applications. Experience with responsible AI, model risk management, AI governance, or technology\-control frameworks.
* Experience scaling AI coding assistants or AI\-enabled developer platforms across a large organization.
* Knowledge of modern AI and machine learning techniques, large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, model evaluation, and agentic workflows.
* Degree in Engineering, Computer Science or Equivalent.

 **What’s in it for you?**


We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

* A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable.
* Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities.
* Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high\-performing team.
* Opportunities to do challenging work.
* Opportunities to take on progressively greater accountabilities.

jobs.description:
We’re building a relationship\-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.


At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.


To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

Reporting to the Vice President \& Chief Operations Officer, Business Operations Division, the Eecutive Director provides enterprise leadership and sets strategic direction for the standards, governance and stewardship frameworks that enable CIHI and its partners, including governments, health systems and other stakeholders, to use health data consistently, responsibly and effectively. ------------------

2\. Lead the development and eecution of portfolio priorities, plans and initiatives to strengthen data standards, governance, stewardship and responsible data use.
  

3\. Oversee the effective allocation of financial, human and technical resources, ensuring sustainable delivery and value for investment.
  

4\. Drive integration and collaboration across portfolios and functions, identifying and removing organizational, operational and other barriers that inhibit progress and the advancement of enterprise priorities.
  

5\. Strengthen integration across related data, analytics, technology, privacy and corporate functions and identify opportunities to strengthen consistency and coordination across the organization.
  

6\. Provide eecutive advice on emerging opportunities, risks, priorities and decisions affecting CIHI’s data standards, governance and stewardship environment.

8\. Lead a high\-performing, multidisciplinary team and foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, inclusion and continuous improvement.
  

9\. Champion change and modernization within the portfolio, challenging established approaches where appropriate and creating the conditions for timely decision\-making, eecution and progress.

* Degree in a relevant discipline, including data Science, health data analytics, information management, governance, business, technology or a related field. An advanced degree is considered an asset.
* Minimum 10\-12 years of progressive eperience leading comple, enterprise\-wide portfolios, initiatives and organizational change in a leadership capacity with a focus on data governance, standards, stewardship, information management or a related environment.
* Strong understanding of data governance, stewardship, standards and related practices, and their role in supporting trusted and effective use of information.

* Demonstrated judgment and decision\-making skills, with the ability to balance strategic priorities, risks, resources and operational considerations.
* Ability to fulfill travel requirements.

6\. Provide executive advice on emerging opportunities, risks, priorities and decisions affecting CIHI’s data capabilities and longer\-term direction.
  

7\. Build strong relationships with internal and external partners to advance shared objectives and support the effective use and evolution of CIHI’s data assets.
  

8\. Lead a high\-performing, multidisciplinary team and foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, inclusion and continuous improvement.
  

9\. Champion change and modernization within the portfolio, challenging established approaches where appropriate and creating the conditions for timely decision\-making, execution and progress.

**What you'll bring to the table**

* Degree in a relevant discipline, including business, health, information management, data, analytics, technology or a related field. An advanced degree is considered an asset.

* Demonstrated ability to work across organizational boundaries, navigate competing priorities and dependencies, and identify and remove barriers that impede execution or organizational progress.
* Strong relationship\-building, consultation, negotiation and communication skills, with the ability to influence and build alignment among senior leaders and diverse internal and external partners.

The Executive Director leads the evolution and integration of analytical capabilities, methodologies and products, ensuring CIHI’s analytics remain relevant, responsive and increasingly enabled by modern analytical approaches, emerging technologies and AI.  

  

The portfolio is focused on turning CIHI’s data into insight, intelligence and value to assess health\-system performance, inform health policy and support health\-system management. 1\. Provide strategic leadership and direction for the Analytics portfolio, aligned with CIHI’s mandate, strategic priorities and evolving information needs.
  

2\. Lead the development and execution of portfolio priorities, plans and initiatives to strengthen CIHI’s analytical capabilities, products and services.
  

3\. Oversee the effective allocation of financial, human and technical resources, ensuring sustainable delivery and value for investment.
  

4\. Drive integration and collaboration across portfolios and functions, identifying and removing organizational, operational and other barriers that inhibit progress and the advancement of enterprise priorities.
  

5\. Strengthen integration across related data, analytics, technology and corporate functions and identify opportunities to improve how analytical work is coordinated and delivered across the organization.
  

6\. Provide executive advice on emerging opportunities, risks, priorities and decisions affecting CIHI’s analytical capabilities and longer\-term direction.
  

7\. Build strong relationships with internal and external partners to advance shared objectives and support the relevance, adoption and impact of CIHI’s analytical work.
  

8\. Lead a high\-performing, multidisciplinary team and foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, inclusion and continuous improvement.
  

9\. Champion change and modernization within the portfolio, challenging established approaches where appropriate and creating the conditions for timely decision\-making, execution and progress.

**What you'll bring to the table**

* Degree in a relevant discipline including health data analytics, statistics, health, business, technology or a related field. An advanced degree is considered an asset.
* Minimum 10\-12 years of progressive experience leading complex, enterprise\-wide portfolios, initiatives and organizational change in a leadership capacity with a focus on analytics, data, research, information or a related environment.
* Strong understanding of analytical practices and the evolving role of analytics, AI and emerging technologies in supporting organizational and health\-system priorities.

* Facilitate process governance activities, including reviewing process design changes and serving as escalation point for items related to the key requirements of the business
* Develop an effective strategic business partnership with globally dispersed team and clients
* Develop content for presentations and reports, as well as supporting analytics, for senior DTTL Leadership including CEO, COO, Global Executive team and Global Board, as required
* Design and facilitate workshops, synthesizing information using analytical frameworks to identify, prioritize, structure, and solve complex business problems
* Lead adoption of consistent and centralized global processes
* Contribute to the success of the team by ensuring work quality of the highest level
**About the team**
------------------


Deloitte Technology works at the forefront of technology development and processes to support and protect Deloitte around the world. In this truly global environment, we operate not in "what is" but rather "what can be" to help Deloitte deliver and connect with its clients, its communities, and one another in ways not previously conceived.

**Enough about us, let’s talk about you**
-----------------------------------------

 **Qualifications**

  

Do you possess the following?:

  

* Bachelor’s Degree required. MBA or other relevant Masters degree preferred. Outstanding academic background: undergraduate degree with rigorous analytical and quantitative focus. 8\-12 years overall experience.
* At least 4 years’ experience from a top tier strategy consulting firm, large Corporate or $1B\+ private enterprise.
* Excellent business acumen needed across sales, quality and risk assessments, and engagement delivery activities.
* High degree of comfort working in an unstructured environment that requires leveraging influence to solve complex, open\-ended issues with varying stakeholder needs.
* Ability to synthesize information and business requirements and structure this into meaningful recommendations.
* Ability to leverage proven techniques to elicit and analyze client needs; ability to provide key input into solutions that meet and often exceed client needs.
* Outstanding research and presentation skills; superior PowerPoint and Excel skills required.
* Demonstrated experience delivering effective business solutions and strategies, frameworks or tools for use at an organization\-wide level

 **Other Qualifications**

  

* Outstanding attention to detail
* Flexibility and ability to pivot work as necessary
* Proactive and results\-oriented player who wants to help build a high\-performance team
* Ability to work well under pressure and act in utmost confidentiality with sensitive leadership information
* Proven track record in navigating through complex organizations, and with strong influencing skills to drive initiatives through to their successful conclusion
* Can interpret business objectives and drivers to shape initiatives to deliver outcomes that fulfil these business objectives
* Ability to work under constantly changing conditions and tight deadlines
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present to and collaborate with business leaders
* Strong ability to communicate across all levels of the organization. Must have demonstrated progressive growth and increased accountability over time
* Demonstrated experience leading and interacting with virtual teams across multiple time zones and in matrix organization
**Total Rewards**
-----------------

  

The salary range for this position is $104,000 \- $215,000, and individuals may be eligible to participate in our bonus program. Deloitte is fair and competitive when it comes to the salaries of our people. We regularly benchmark across a variety of positions, industries, sectors, targets, and levels. Our approach is grounded on recognizing people's unique strengths and contributions and rewarding the value that they deliver.

At Shoppers Drug Mart, we’re innovating health and wellness in Canada. From prescriptions to walk\-in clinics, and a beloved loyalty program, we’re caring and supporting our customers in new ways every day.  

With more than 1,300 locally owned and operated stores from coast to coast, the Shoppers Drug Mart network is more than a great place to shop, it’s a great place to work. Does working with some of Canada’s most talented minds in innovation supporting retail, digital consumer solutions and analytical platforms excite you? Loblaw Technology powers some of Canada’s most game\-changing retail solutions, giving our customers the ability to live their lives well.

We are looking for a highly technical, business\-oriented Director, Virtual Care Technology Applications to help lead the strategy, modernization, and evolution of our Virtual Care program within Pharmacy and Healthcare Technology.

* Provide guidance to engineering and delivery teams to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable, reliable, and designed for future growth.
* Translate complex technical concepts into clear business language for senior leaders and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Prepare and present recommendations, decision points, roadmap options, risks, and trade\-offs to support informed decision\-making.
* Collaborate across a matrixed environment and build alignment between business needs, digital priorities, technical strategy, and operational realities.
* Support investment planning, vendor discussions, technology evaluations, and business cases related to the Virtual Care platform.
* Help ensure technology investments deliver meaningful value to patients, pharmacy teams, healthcare professionals, and the broader organization.

* Significant experience in technology leadership, enterprise consulting, solution architecture, application development, or a related field, ideally within healthcare, pharmacy, digital health, or another regulated environment.

new_jobs.title: Senior Director - Chief Developer and AI Adoption
new_jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**What is the opportunity?**


As a Senior Director \- Chief Developer and AI Adoption, you will lead a team of Technology \& Operations AI Developers who build the next\-generation technology that changes how millions of people interact with financial information and one another. Our products need to handle information on a massive scale and extend well beyond traditional banking.

  

The RBC Business Financial Service Technology team offers the opportunity to work within the transformation program to develop innovative ideas and solutions in support of our clients and organization. We hire people with a broad range of technical skills and leadership experience. Our teams are diverse, creative and fun. As a Sr. Director, you will work within and across teams focusing on how we can empower our clients on their digital journey. Working with amazing colleagues and a variety of technological options you will be contributing to new innovative possibilities, solving interesting and challenging business problems and helping to deliver solutions that result in targeted business outcomes and great client experience.

  

This executive will establish a modern, secure, scalable, and AI\-enabled development organization. The role combines hands\-on technology leadership with enterprise\-wide transformation, ensuring that AI and automation deliver measurable improvements while meeting the bank’s standards for security, resilience, regulatory compliance, data protection, and responsible innovation.

  

The successful candidate will champion developer productivity, modern engineering practices, cloud and platform capabilities, reusable technology services, and the adoption of AI\-assisted development tools. They will partner closely with business leaders, risk, compliance, information security, data, operations, and human resources to embed AI into the bank’s operating model.

 **What will you do?**

* Maintaining relationships with clients; communicating with IT and business management. Monitoring prompt response and support for technical issues.
* Lead high performing teams, and ensure high standards and quality of technical work. Directing reviews of tools and technologies for improving performance, reducing costs and time to market.
* Define the bank’s strategy for AI\-assisted software development and engineering productivity. Partner with business and functional leaders to identify high\-value, practical AI use cases. Build communities of practice, internal learning programs, and technical enablement initiatives for developers and business users.
* Lead the adoption of approved AI coding assistants, code\-generation tools, testing tools, documentation solutions, developer copilots, and software delivery automation.
* Ensure AI and software development practices comply with applicable banking regulations, supervisory expectations, internal policies, and contractual obligations.
* Establish appropriate controls for the use of generative AI in development, including secure handling of source code, customer data, confidential information, and intellectual property.
* Develop standards for human review, model evaluation, testing, explainability, auditability, and accountability when AI is used in software development.
* Measure and communicate the impact of AI adoption on productivity, quality, delivery speed, risk, and employee experience.
* Own or contribute to technology investment planning, prioritization, and budget management.

 **What do you need to succeed?**

**Must\-have:**

* 5\- 10 years’ experience with Java, .NET, Angular (or relevant frameworks), REST API/Micro services, Spring Framework (MVC, Security, JPA, Boot), Ansi SQL (MySQL or equivalent)
* Experience with distributed cloud (Pivotal Cloud Foundry, Openshift, Docker)
* Experience in designing, developing, testing and troubleshooting code. Experience with security gateways and protocols (JWT, Oauth2\.0, SSL Certificates, Azure AD)
* Experience with event driven capabilities like Kafka. Microservices architecture design, development and implementation.
* Experience with secure CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience leveraging Gen\-AI capabilities including Claude, CoPilot or others to generate code, data \& deliver applications. Experience with responsible AI, model risk management, AI governance, or technology\-control frameworks.
* Experience scaling AI coding assistants or AI\-enabled developer platforms across a large organization.
* Knowledge of modern AI and machine learning techniques, large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, model evaluation, and agentic workflows.
* Degree in Engineering, Computer Science or Equivalent.

 **What’s in it for you?**


We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

* A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable.
* Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities.
* Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high\-performing team.
* Opportunities to do challenging work.
* Opportunities to take on progressively greater accountabilities.
